'''Tethris Aran''' is a series of [[night elf|night elven]] ruins found in northern [[Desolace]] just north of [[Thunder Axe Fortress]].{{coords|54|14|Desolace}} The ruins are inhabited only by the wild creatures of Desolace. The night elven settlement that was here was presumably destroyed by the [[Great Sundering]].
